route_summary: Blind exhaustive census of centrally symmetric {0,+-1}^4-vertex polytopes up to 22 vertices (1.77M distinct bodies up to B4): minimum volume product is exactly 32/3, attained only by Hanner polytopes (1113 orbits, all GL-certified), with a spectral gap of ~0.146 to the nearest non-attainer. Skeptic-confirmed. No counterexample lives in this universe.
